title: Mitochondrial CO1 Gene Analysis Protocol for Sharks
author: Sutanto Hadi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfwmjpc6
materials: Shark Tissue Sampling Prepare sampling tools and equipment: camera, ruler or scale band, gloves, scissors or cutter and tweezers, tube, ethanol 96%, ID label, and sampling form for writing sample information details.

Put mixing tube into thermocycler PCR machine and set reaction at these conditions: pre-denaturation at 94°C for 15 seconds; followed by 38 cycles of denaturation at 94°C for 30 seconds, annealing at 50°C for 30 seconds, and extension at 72°C for 45 seconds, and a final extension at 72°C for 10 minutes [4,5]. After that, continue with electrophoresis step.

steps.title: Sample Collection and Documentation
steps.instruction: Collect shark specimens and record all necessary biological and location data.

substeps.instruction: Take a full-length photograph of the shark with a scale.
Measure total length (TL) in centimeters and total weight in kilograms.
Collect a tissue sample (typically from where the fin was cut) and cut into small pieces (~1-3 cm) using scissors or a cutter.
Place tissue in a tube containing 96% ethanol.
Label each tube with the number, location, and date of collection.

Record detailed sample information: landing site, date-month-year, species name, sex, total length, total weight, fishing ground, and other necessary details (via observation or fisherman interviews).

steps.title: Tissue Sample Dissociation
steps.instruction: Dissociate the shark tissue to prepare for DNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Transfer up to 25 mg of shark tissue to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 200 μl of GST Buffer and 20 μl of Proteinase K, then vortex thoroughly.
Incubate at 60ºC overnight or until the lysate becomes clear.
During incubation, transfer 200 μl of Elution Buffer per sample to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube and heat to 60ºC.

steps.title: Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells to release DNA.

substeps.instruction: If insoluble material remains after incubation, centrifuge for 2 minutes at 14-16,000 x g.
Carefully transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 200 μl of GSB Buffer and shake vigorously for 10 seconds to ensure a homogeneous solution.

steps.title: DNA Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to the GS Column.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μl of absolute ethanol to the sample lysate and shake vigorously for 10 seconds.
Break up any precipitates with a pipette.
Place a GS Column in a 2 ml Collection Tube and transfer the entire mixture (including precipitate) to the column.
Centrifuge at 14-16,000 x g for 1 minute (increase time if the mixture does not flow through completely).
Discard the 2 ml Collection Tube and transfer the GS Column to a new 2 ml Collection Tube.

steps.title: DNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 μl of W1 Buffer to the GS Column.
Centrifuge at 14-16,000 x g for 30 seconds and discard the flow-through.
Place the GS Column back in the 2 ml Collection Tube.
Add 600 μl of Wash Buffer (containing absolute ethanol) to the GS Column.
Centrifuge at 14-16,000 x g for 30 seconds and discard the flow-through.
Place the GS Column back in the 2 ml Collection Tube and centrifuge for 3 minutes at 14-16,000 x g to dry the column matrix.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the dried GS Column to a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 100 μl of pre-heated Elution Buffer to the center of the column matrix.
Let stand for at least 3 minutes.
Centrifuge at 14-16,000 x g for 30 seconds to elute the DNA.
Store the DNA extraction products for amplification.

steps.title: PCR Amplification of CO1 Gene
steps.instruction: Amplify the mitochondrial Cytochrome Oxidase subunit-I (CO1) gene using PCR.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the PCR mix in a tube with: 12.5 μL MyTaq HS Red Mix, 9 μL ddH2O, 1.25 μL fish-BCL primer (5'–TCA ACY AAT CAY AAA GAT ATY GGC AC–3'), and 1.25 μL fish-BCH primer (5'–ACT TCY GGG TGR CCR AAR AAT CA–3').
Add 3 μL of the DNA template (extraction product) to the mix.
Centrifuge or vortex for 5-10 seconds to ensure thorough mixing.

steps.title: Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Verify the PCR product using agarose gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 1.5% agarose gel containing ethidium bromide.
Load 100 bp DNA ladder into the first well as a marker.
Load 3 μL of PCR product into another well.
Electrophorese at 100 V for 20 minutes.
Observe the DNA bands under a UV transilluminator to identify the presence of fragments.
Perform sequencing on PCR products with confirmed bands using a sequencing machine following the optimized Sanger method.
